Cookie Policy

Effective date: 10 September 2026 · VF Empire Corp Ltd, Malta, EU

Short version: this site uses no advertising cookies, no analytics cookies and no tracking of any kind. We build private-by-architecture systems; the company website behaves the same way.

1. What cookies are

Cookies are small text files that a website stores on your device. Related technologies (localStorage, sessionStorage) store data in your browser in a similar way. EU law — the ePrivacy Directive 2002/58/EC as implemented in Malta, together with the GDPR — requires consent for any storage that is not strictly necessary for a service you have requested.

2. What vfempire.com stores

NAMETYPEPURPOSEDURATIONCATEGORY
vf-consentlocalStorageRemembers your accept/decline choice in our cookie notice so we do not ask on every visit. Never transmitted anywhere.Until you clear itStrictly necessary
__cf_bm / cf_clearance (only if issued)Cookie (Cloudflare)Bot management and security challenges by our infrastructure provider, to protect the Site against automated abuse. Set only when Cloudflare’s security layer requires it.Minutes to hoursStrictly necessary

That is the complete list. There are no first-party analytics, no third-party pixels, no fingerprinting, no cross-site identifiers.

3. Why we still show a notice

Because we believe you should hear it from us directly — and so that, if we ever introduce an optional category (for example privacy-respecting analytics), the consent mechanics are already honest and in place. Nothing optional loads today whether you accept or decline; declining changes nothing except recording your preference.

4. Managing your choice

You can reset your choice at any time:

You can also clear storage in your browser settings (usually under Privacy → Clear browsing data), or block cookies entirely for this site — the Site will work fully without them.

5. Changes

If we ever add a storage category, this page and the consent notice will be updated before anything new is stored, and anything non-essential will remain off until you opt in.
